{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.24

|gr1= VR

|descr= Spawns the course selector (used primarily for VR missions).

|s1= [center, type] call [[BIS_fnc_VRSpawnSelector]]

|p1= center: [[Position]]
|p2= type: [[String]] - (Optional, default "default") can be:<br>
"default" (blue)<br>
"incomplete" (orange)<br>
"complete" (dark orange)<br>
"exit" (red)

|r1= [[Object]] - created object for easy deletion

|x1= <sqf>[[0,0,0], "exit"] call BIS_fnc_VRSpawnSelector;</sqf>
